quote: the generation process of Scalable-DSC can be divided into two steps: (1) Generating the phrase 'The following dialogue status is incorrect' and then generate the incorrect parts of the state sequence; (2) Generating the phrase 'Actually' and then generating a complete and correct state sequence.

The generation approach forces Scalable-DSC to firstly generate a sequence of erroneous states and then continue generating a sequence of corrected states. ... Scalable-DSC corrects the prediction results of the DST model ... generating a corrected dialogue state natural language sequence.
Task-oriented dialogue systems are becoming increasingly important in facilitating the daily life of human beings. Dialogue State Tracking module plays an important role in dialogue systems
outputs: Corrected dialogue state sequences expressed as natural language text
The model generates corrected dialogue state natural language sequences from erroneous predicted dialogue states using a template-based generation approach.

quote: The model is automatically evaluated based on two metrics . Joint Goal Accuracy is the primary evaluation metric for cross-domain DST tasks. It is the percentage of turns for which all the slots are correctly identified. Slot Accuracy only considers individual slot-level accuracy, calculating the proportion of the correct slot values filled in the slot from a macro perspective.
